description: Deploy a project to DenkOps by sending its files, and get the live URL back. Include every source file (and denkops.json if the project has one; without it a new project is created, named from `name`, package.json or pyproject.toml). Pass project_id to ship a new version of an existing project. Secrets do not belong in files: .env files are rejected (set environment variables separately). Limits: 500 files, 5 MB.

content.description: File content (UTF-8 text, or base64 when encoding is base64)

path.description: Relative path inside the project, e.g. src/index.ts

name.description: Project name for a first deploy without denkops.json

project_id.description: Existing project to deploy a new version to

name: deploy
title: Deploy to DenkOps
